questions.question: Is your system an AI system within the meaning of the AI Act?
Is the AI System or its output used exclusively for one or more of the following areas?

allowedAnswers.label: Military, defense or national security
Scientific research and development
The AI system or its output is not used exclusively within the areas listed above

questions.question: Is the AI System used by a public authority of a third country OR an international organisation for international cooperation or law enforcement?
Is the AI system used in research, testing or development activity and has not been placed on the market or put into service?

Is the system made available under a free and open-source licence?
Is the AI System's output used in the EU?
Will the AI system be placed on the market or put into service in the EU?
Does the AI system perform, enable, or is it intended to be used for one or more of the following practices? You can indicate more than one practice if appropriate for the AI system.

allowedAnswers.label: Biometric categorisation to infer race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life, or sexual orientation
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system uses biometric categorisation systems that categorise individual persons based on their biometric data to deduce or infer their race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life or sexual orientation.

allowedAnswers.label: Use of subliminal, intentionally manipulative, or deceptive techniques
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system uses subliminal, intentionally manipulative, or deceptive techniques. Whether these techniques affect the ability to make an informed decision and cause or are reasonably likely to cause significant harm is assessed in the follow-up questions.

allowedAnswers.label: Exploitation of vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or a particular social or economic situation
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system exploits vulnerabilities of a person or a particular group of persons due to age, disability, or a particular social or economic situation. Whether this materially distorts behaviour in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm is assessed in the follow-up question.

allowedAnswers.label: Evaluation or classification of persons based on social behaviour or personal characteristics
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system evaluates or classifies a person over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or personal characteristics, whether known, inferred, or predicted. Whether this results in specific detrimental or unfavourable treatment is assessed in the follow-up questions.

allowedAnswers.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system uses real-time remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes. The applicable exception conditions are assessed in the follow-up questions.

allowedAnswers.label: Assessment or prediction of a person's risk of committing a criminal offence based on their profile, personality traits, or characteristics
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system conducts risk assessments of persons to assess or predict a person's risk of committing a criminal offence solely on the basis of the person's profile or an assessment of their personality traits and characteristics. Whether the system only supports a human assessment based on objective and verifiable facts is assessed in the follow-up question.

allowedAnswers.label: Creation or expansion of facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system creates or expands facial recognition databases through the untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage.

allowedAnswers.label: Emotion analysis or inference in workplace or educational institutions not intended for medical or safety reasons
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system analyses or infers the emotions of a person in the workplace or educational institutions and the use is not intended for medical or safety reasons.

allowedAnswers.label: Generation or manipulation of realistic intimate or explicit representations of identifiable persons without the required consent
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system generates or manipulates realistic intimate or explicit representations of identifiable natural persons in images, videos, audio, or similar content without the required consent.

allowedAnswers.label: Creation or manipulation of material or representations within the meaning of Directive 2011/93/EU
allowedAnswers.optionSemantics: Select when the AI system is used for the creation or manipulation of material or representations within the meaning of Directive 2011/93/EU.

allowedAnswers.label: None of the listed prohibited practices apply

questions.question: For the identified biometric categorisation to infer sensitive or protected characteristics, does the AI system merely label or filter a lawfully obtained biometric data set?

For the identified biometric categorisation to infer sensitive or protected characteristics, is the processing of the biometric data set done exclusively within the legally defined area of law enforcement?

Do the identified subliminal, intentionally manipulative, or deceptive techniques affect a person's ability to make an informed decision and lead, or are they reasonably likely to lead, the person to make a decision that they would not otherwise have made?
Does the behavioural distortion resulting from the identified subliminal, intentionally manipulative, or deceptive techniques cause, or is it reasonably likely to cause, significant harm?

Does the identified exploitation of vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or a particular social or economic situation have the objective or effect of materially distorting the behaviour of the person or group in a manner that causes, or is reasonably likely to cause, significant harm?

Does the identified evaluation or classification based on social behaviour or personal characteristics result in detrimental or unfavourable treatment of a person in a social context unrelated to the context in which the data was originally generated or collected?

Does the identified evaluation or classification based on social behaviour or personal characteristics result in detrimental or unfavourable treatment that is unjustified or disproportionate to the person's social behaviour or its gravity?
For the identified use of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes, is there a specifically documented legal exception purpose?

For the identified use of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes, are the target person or target group, spatial and temporal boundaries, as well as the severity, likelihood, and extent of the harm documented?
For the identified use of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes, was a fundamental rights impact assessment carried out?

For the identified use of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes, is the required prior approval from a judicial authority or an independent administrative authority in place, or is a legally regulated urgent exception documented?

For the identified assessment or prediction of a person's risk of committing a criminal offence based on their profile, personality traits, or characteristics, does the system only support a human assessment that is already based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to criminal activity?

questions.question: Does the AI system use remote biometric identification for any purpose other than to confirm that a particular person is the person he or she claims to be?
Will the AI system be used for biometric categorization according to sensitive or protected characteristics or traits, or to infer such characteristics or traits?
Will the AI system be used for emotion recognition?
Will the AI system be used as a safety component in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, such as water, gas, heating, electricity, or road traffic?
Is the AI system intended to be used to determine access, admission, or to assign individuals to educational and vocational training institutions or programs?

Is the AI system intended to be used for evaluating learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to guide the learning process of persons in educational and vocational training institutions or programs?

Is the AI system intended to be used for the purpose of assessing the appropriate educational level for an individual and significantly influencing the level of education and vocational training that the individual will receive or will be able to access?
Is the AI system intended to be used to monitor and detect prohibited student behavior during tests in educational and vocational training institutions?
Is the AI system intended to be used to place targeted job advertisements?
Is the AI system intended to be used for recruitment and selection of persons, to analyse, rank, filter job applications, or to evaluate candidates?
Will the AI system be used to make decisions about hiring, working conditions, promotion, or contract termination?
Within employment, worker management, or access to self-employment, will the AI system be used to assign tasks based on individual behaviour or personal characteristics?
Will the AI system be used to monitor and evaluate the performance or behaviour of persons in employment, worker management, or self-employment relationships?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of public authorities to evaluate the eligibility of natural persons for public assistance benefits and services, including healthcare services, as well as to grant, reduce, revoke, or reclaim such benefits and services?
Is the AI system intended to be used for assessing the creditworthiness of persons or determining their credit score?

Is the AI system intended to evaluate and classify emergency calls from people, or to be used to dispatch or prioritize emergency first responders, including police, firefighters, and medical aid, as well as emergency healthcare patient triage systems?
Will the AI system be used for risk assessment and pricing for individuals in life and health insurance?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, agencies, offices or bodies in support of law enforcement authorities or on their behalf to assess the risk of a person becoming the victim of a criminal offence?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities, or by Union agencies, offices, or bodies in support of law enforcement authorities to evaluate the reliability of evidence during the investigation or prosecution of criminal offences?

Is the AI system intended to be used by law enforcement authorities or on their behalf or by Union institutions, agencies, offices or bodies in support of law enforcement authorities for assessing the risk of a person offending or re-offending?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, agencies, offices or bodies in support of law enforcement authorities for profiling of persons?
Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies for crime analytics?

Is the AI system intended to be used by competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies to assess a person's risk, including security, irregular migration or health risks?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union agencies, offices or bodies to assess a risk posed by a person who intends to enter or has entered the territory of a Member State?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union agencies, offices or bodies to assist competent public authorities in examining and assessing the reliability of evidence related to applications?

Is the AI system intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities, including Union agencies, offices or bodies, in the context of migration, asylum and border control management, for the purpose of detection, recognition or identification of natural persons?

Is the AI system intended to be used by a judicial authority or on their behalf to assist a judicial authority in researching and interpreting facts, the law and in applying the law to a concrete set of facts or used in a similar way in alternative dispute resolution?

answerSemantics.YES: The condition applies when the documented intended use falls within the judicial or alternative dispute resolution activities described in the question.

questions.question: Is the AI system intended to be used to influence the outcome of an election or referendum, or the voting behaviour of individuals in the exercise of their right to vote in an election or referendum?

answerSemantics.YES: The condition applies when the documented intended use falls within the activity described in the question. This does not include AI systems the output of which natural persons are not directly exposed to, such as tools used to organise, optimise or structure political campaigns from an administrative or logistical point of view.

questions.question: Is the AI system used for profiling of natural persons?

Are you developing the AI system or GPAI model, or have you had it developed, in order to put it into service or place it on the market under your own name or trademark?
Have you put, or are you planning to put, your name or trademark on a high-risk AI system that has already been placed on the market or put into service?
Have you made, or are you planning to make, a substantial modification to an AI system that has already been placed on the market or put into service?
Have you made, or are you planning to make, a modification to the intended purpose of the AI system?
Is the AI system intended to interact with natural persons?
Does the AI system generate or manipulate synthetic audio, image, video, or text content?
Does the AI system generate or manipulate audio or visual content, including images or video, that would falsely appear to be authentic or truthful (deepfake)?
